subject: Apply a silver gelatin black-and-white noir LUT. See .rundeer/luts/noir_silver_gelatin.md for the full LUT specification. Convert to monochrome using a luminance-weighted channel mixer that favors the red channel for natural skin tones, deep shadow crush, bright specular highlights with a silver metallic sheen, high overall contrast, subtle vignette. Add a faint warm ivory tone to the paper base (not pure white), giving the feel of developed silver-gelatin fiber paper. Preserve all composition, lighting, and subject identity.
